department: Department of Chemistry (Center for Photochemical Sciences)

deadline.value: Fall applications are due March 1, 2027; spring applications are due November 1.
deadline.quote: Photochemical Sciences - PhD (Main) (Fall Admission Only) ... Fall Mar 1; Spring Nov 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for the Photochemical Sciences application.
gre_general.quote: Official Graduate Record Exam (GRE) is not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE, including the Chemistry subject test, is required.
gre_subject.quote: Official Graduate Record Exam (GRE) is not required.

toefl_min.value: The department still lists a minimum iBT TOEFL of 80 (old scale), which overrides the Graduate College minimum for this program.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum total TOEFL score required in order to be eligible to apply is 80 on the Internet-based test

supervisor.value: The department states no supervisor-agreement rule for admission.

funding.value: Financial assistance is limited and offered to applicants on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Only limited amount of financial assistance (stipends, tuition waiver, non-resident fee coverage for out-of-state students) is available.

entry_route.value: Outstanding applicants may enter directly after a bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, physics or a related field.
entry_route.quote: may enter directly into the Ph.D program after completing a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, physics or related disciplines

notes: Physics: the Ph.D. covers chemistry and physics (also_fields).
